Color presets for volcano plots

Source: R/palettes.R
ggvolc_palettes.Rd

Lists the color presets available through the palette argument of ggvolc and genes_table. Each preset sets the color of downregulated, non-significant, and upregulated genes.

Usage

ggvolc_palettes()

Value

A data frame with one row per preset and columns palette, down, not_sig, up, colorblind_safe, and source.

Details

Presets marked colorblind_safe keep the up and down colors clearly apart under simulated deuteranopia, protanopia, and tritanopia (checked with colorspace). Several presets come from the ltc palettes; ltc does not need to be installed to use them.

You are not limited to these presets: palette also accepts a named color vector such as c(down = "navy", up = "firebrick"). That makes any palette usable, for example one from ltc: pal <- ltc::ltc("maya"); ggvolc(all_genes, palette = c(down = pal[1], up = pal[4])).

Examples

ggvolc_palettes()
#>     palette    down not_sig      up colorblind_safe             source
#> 1   default #00798c #808080 #d1495b           FALSE         ltc: minou
#> 2 okabe_ito #0072B2 #999999 #D55E00            TRUE Okabe & Ito (2008)
#> 3      rdbu #0571b0 #999999 #ca0020            TRUE   ColorBrewer RdBu
#> 4 pantone23 #1F2C43 #B8B8B8 #FFB000            TRUE     ltc: pantone23
#> 5  seafarer #013D5A #BDBDBD #E4A25B            TRUE      ltc: seafarer
#> 6  midnight #075056 #B0B0B0 #FF5B04           FALSE      ltc: midnight
#> 7      maya #3d5a80 #A9A9A9 #ee6c4d           FALSE          ltc: maya
#> 8     trio1 #0E7175 #B0B0B0 #FD7901           FALSE         ltc: trio1

ggvolc(all_genes, palette = "okabe_ito")

ggvolc(all_genes, palette = c(down = "navy", up = "firebrick"))
